//: Isolated PHPUnit 9.6 toolchain for the INTEGRATION layer only. The WordPress core test framework (wp-phpunit) is not compatible with PHPUnit 10+ (it calls PHPUnit\Util\Test::parseTestMethodAnnotations(), removed in 10). The main composer.json keeps PHPUnit 10+ for the fast isolated unit suite; this separate vendor tree provides the 9.6 runner + Yoast polyfills the WP test bootstrap requires, with no conflict.
